Description
Fairmont Preparatory Academy is a private, college preparatory high school located in sunny Orange County, California. The school’s reputation for academic excellence is proven by its rigorous academic curriculums that features 25 AP courses, IB Diploma Program, and various specialized academic programs including Math, Engineering, and International Business. Fairmont boasts its individualized learning and college preparation, and the school’s graduating classes are accepted into the top colleges and universities in the US.
